answer: Coordination-Prism Deposit Routing: each agent action emits a routing receipt split across three independently operated channels, and settlement requires the receipt’s three fragments to agree on a shared origin. Every new identity raises the matching cost on all its neighbors, so a ripple of duplicate accounts forces the attacker to fund redundant receipts that cancel out. A walnut-shaped overlap check flags any cluster whose internal agreement exceeds a threshold, freezing its payouts until distinct external confirmations arrive.
